q: The full group [T] of a measure-preserving transformation T consists of all MPT S such that S(x) ∈ {T^n(x) : n ∈ ℤ} a.e. The group [T] completely determines the orbit equivalence class because:
opts: Dye's reconstruction theorem: T and T' are OE iff [T] and [T'] are isomorphic as abstract groups
exp: Dye's reconstruction: [T] as an abstract group (without its action) completely encodes the orbit equivalence class. Two ergodic MPTs are OE iff their full groups are isomorphic as abstract groups. This 'algebraisation' of OE is a profound result.
